info.name: SLSEA Real-Time Solar Generation Monitoring REST API
info.description:
Enterprise Postman Collection v2.1 for the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority (SLSEA) Solar Generation Tracking Platform.

Covers:
1. Zero-Trust Authentication (National, Provincial, District, IoT Device)
2. Hierarchical Topology Traversal (Provinces -> Districts -> GSS -> Solar Installations)
3. Telemetry Ingestion (Single & High-Throughput Batch) & Operational Reads
4. Grid Analytics & Operational Dashboards (District & National Summaries)
5. System Readiness & Liveness Probes
6. Rigorous Negative Edge-Case & Error Contract Assertions (400, 401, 403, 404, 406, 412, 422, 429)
